Name: PRF_PlanRenewal_OpenAPI

Data.scheme:
openapi: 3.0.0
info:
  title: EarthLink Plan Renewal & Payment Aggregation API
  description: Real-time REST API for Subscriber Plan Renewals with Deduplication & SAP HANA Posting
  version: 1.0.0
servers:
  - url: 'http://10.4.4.128:8090/v1'
    description: EarthLink MZ Development Server
tags:
  - name: planRenewal
    description: Operations for Subscriber Plan Renewals
paths:
  /plan/renew:
    post:
      tags:
        - planRenewal
      summary: Renew subscriber plan with duplicate request interception
      operationId: renewPlan
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/PlanRenewalRequest'
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Plan Renewal successfully processed and posted to SAP HANA
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/PlanRenewalResponseSuccess'
        '409':
          description: Duplicate request intercepted by MediationZone Aggregation Profile
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/PlanRenewalResponseDuplicate'
components:
  schemas:
    PlanRenewalRequest:
      type: object
      required:
        - transactionId
        - subscriberId
        - planId
        - amount
      properties:
        transactionId:
          type: string
          example: 'TXN_RENEW_99001'
        subscriberId:
          type: string
          example: 'SUB_44012'
        planId:
          type: string
          example: 'PLAN_FIBER_100M'
        amount:
          type: number
          format: double
          example: 45000.0
        channel:
          type: string
          example: 'MOBILE_APP'
    PlanRenewalResponseSuccess:
      type: object
      properties:
        status:
          type: string
          example: 'SUCCESS'
        message:
          type: string
          example: 'Plan renewal successfully processed and posted to SAP HANA'
        transactionId:
          type: string
        subscriberId:
          type: string
        planId:
          type: string
        amount:
          type: number
        sapInvoiceDocNo:
          type: string
          example: '300098445'
    PlanRenewalResponseDuplicate:
      type: object
      properties:
        status:
          type: string
          example: 'FAILED'
        errorCode:
          type: string
          example: 'ERR_DUPLICATE_REQUEST'
        message:
          type: string
          example: 'Duplicate Request detected by MZ Aggregation Profile'
        transactionId:
          type: string
        sessionCount:
          type: integer
          example: 2

documentation: OpenAPI 3.0 specification for EarthLink Plan Renewal REST API
